mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_skin (skin_name, idle_ani, click_ani, main_img, is_default, status, create_time) VALUES (#{skinName}, #{idleAni}, #{clickAni}, #{mainImg}, #{isDefault}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pet_skin ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM pet_skin WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM pet_skin WHERE is_default = 1 AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_skin SET is_default = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
